title: City of Melbourne road segments with surface type: every road surface the City manages (carriageways, footways, kerbs, channels, medians, nature strips), with its condition rating at its last evaluation, its installation date and its design life
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset road-segments-with-surface-type
credit: Road segments with surface type: City of Melbourne, CC BY
licence: CC BY (the dataset's metadata, license: CC BY; checked 2026-11-04)
citation: City of Melbourne, Road segments with surface type, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/road-segments-with-surface-type/
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark; one row a surface polygon. Fields selected: assetid; class (Road, ...); type (Road Carriageway, Road Footway, Road Kerb, Road Channel, Road Arterial, ...); area (m2); company and responsibleauthoritycommonname (City of Melbourne, VicRoads, ...); ownership (Owned, Not Owned); conditionrating (a real number from 1, failed, to 5, good; empty where never rated); evaluationdate (the date of that rating); installationdate; designlife (years); surfacematerial (HMA, concrete, bluestone, ...); segtype; roadsegmentdescription (the street and its ends); geo_point_2d (WGS 84, the polygon's point). Only the latest rating is published: no history of ratings or repairs; a renewal probably resets the installation date.
coverage: The municipality, 61,424 surfaces on 2026-11-04 (the dataset modified 2026-09-10); the profile takes the Hoddle Grid's box, -37.8205 to -37.8075 S and 144.9535 to 144.9735 E, by the API's in_bbox on geo_point_2d (about 9,900 surfaces, 9,600 of them rated).

south.description: southern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

west.description: western edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

north.description: northern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

east.description: eastern edge of the box (degrees, WGS 84)

hoddle-grid.description: The Hoddle Grid's road surfaces (about 2 MB; fetch again with --refresh after the City's update, so that ratings accumulate as a panel)
